steps.name: Build/start synthetic demo (single command)
Verify local-only API, fictional organization and random login
steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time,urllib.request,urllib.error,pathlib
api='http://127.0.0.1:8000'
ui='http://127.0.0.1:5173'
for n in range(75):
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(api+'/openapi.json',timeout=3).close()
        urllib.request.urlopen(ui+'/',timeout=3).close()
        break
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(2)
else:raise AssertionError('Demo frontend/API never became healthy')
password=pathlib.Path('.demo-private/admin-password').read_text().strip()
assert len(password)>=20 and password!='admin'
body=json.dumps({'username':'demo-admin','password':password}).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request(api+'/api/v1/auth/login',body,
    {'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as response:
    token=json.load(response)['access_token']
req=urllib.request.Request(api+'/api/v1/auth/me',
    headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as response:
    identity=json.load(response)
assert identity['all_customers_authorized'], 'Demo administrator lacks explicit ALL authority'
req=urllib.request.Request(api+'/api/v1/organizations',
    headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,
             'X-OpsControl-Customers':'ALL'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as response:
    orgs=json.load(response)
assert any(x['code']=='DEMO-LAB' for x in orgs),orgs
assert all('example' in x['name'].lower() or 'fictional' in x['name'].lower() for x in orgs),orgs
print('PUBLIC-SAFE LOCALHOST DEMO SMOKE PASSED')
PY

steps.name: Start isolated disposable API and PostgreSQL
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p .demo-private
chmod 700 .demo-private
umask 077
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,secrets
pathlib.Path(".demo-private/admin-password").write_text(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))
PY
if ! docker pull public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:17; then
  # Public ECR occasionally rate-limits anonymous CI. Use the same
  # official PostgreSQL 17 image from Docker Hub for this disposable lab.
  docker pull postgres:17
  docker tag postgres:17 public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:17
fi
docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up --build -d postgres api
for i in {1..75}; do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/openapi.json >/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 2
done
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/openapi.json >/dev/null

steps.name: Launch TLS target and outbound-only agent on separate isolated networks
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /tmp/opscontrol-fixture
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 1 \
  -keyout /tmp/opscontrol-fixture/tls.key -out /tmp/opscontrol-fixture/tls.crt \
  -subj '/CN=portal.example.test' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:portal.example.test' >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 600 /tmp/opscontrol-fixture/tls.key
echo healthy >/tmp/opscontrol-fixture/state
docker network create --internal --subnet 172.28.77.0/24 opscontrol-fixture-target-net
docker network create --internal --subnet 172.28.78.0/24 opscontrol-fixture-control-net
api_id="$(docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml ps -q api)"
docker network connect --alias opscontrol-control opscontrol-fixture-control-net "$api_id"
docker run -d --name opscontrol-private-fixture --network opscontrol-fixture-target-net \
  --ip 172.28.77.10 --network-alias portal.example.test \
  -v /tmp/opscontrol-fixture:/fixture:ro \
  -v "$PWD/deploy/fixtures/private_https_target.py:/app.py:ro" \
  python:3.12-alpine python /app.py
docker run -d --name opscontrol-private-agent --network opscontrol-fixture-target-net \
  -v "$PWD/backend:/src:ro" -v "$PWD/deploy/fixtures:/tests:ro" \
  -v /tmp/opscontrol-fixture/tls.crt:/fixture/ca.crt:ro \
  -e SSL_CERT_FILE=/fixture/ca.crt -e PYTHONPATH=/src \
  python:3.12-alpine sleep 3600
docker network connect opscontrol-fixture-control-net opscontrol-private-agent
for i in {1..20}; do
  if docker exec opscontrol-private-fixture python -c \
      'import socket;socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",443),1).close()' 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done

steps.name: Verify real healthy → failed → recovered evidence and native alert lifecycle
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
api_id="$(docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml ps -q api)"
token="$(docker exec "$api_id" python -m scripts.live_https_acceptance setup)"
test -n "$token"
docker exec -e OPSCONTROL_WORKER_TOKEN="$token" opscontrol-private-agent python /tests/agent_cycle.py
docker exec "$api_id" python -m scripts.live_https_acceptance healthy
echo failed >/tmp/opscontrol-fixture/state
docker exec "$api_id" python -m scripts.live_https_acceptance schedule
docker exec -e OPSCONTROL_WORKER_TOKEN="$token" opscontrol-private-agent python /tests/agent_cycle.py
docker exec "$api_id" python -m scripts.live_https_acceptance failed
echo healthy >/tmp/opscontrol-fixture/state
docker exec "$api_id" python -m scripts.live_https_acceptance schedule
docker exec -e OPSCONTROL_WORKER_TOKEN="$token" opscontrol-private-agent python /tests/agent_cycle.py
docker exec "$api_id" python -m scripts.live_https_acceptance recovered

steps.name: Assert network-level containment
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker network inspect -f '{{.Internal}}' opscontrol-fixture-target-net)" = true
test "$(docker network inspect -f '{{.Internal}}' opscontrol-fixture-control-net)" = true
docker exec opscontrol-private-agent python -c 'import socket
s=socket.socket();s.settimeout(2)
try:
    s.connect(("1.1.1.1",443))
    raise AssertionError("Unapproved internet egress unexpectedly allowed")
except (OSError,TimeoutError):
    print("PASS: private agent has no public network egress")'

steps.name: Require committed exact-SHA authorization before any build or privileged host
Guard pilot and immutable source
steps.command:
test "$ENABLED" = true
[[ "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
if [[ "$OPERATION" = deploy_main ]]; then
  branch=main
else
  branch="$SOURCE_BRANCH"
  [[ "$branch" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,127}$ ]]
  [[ "$branch" != main && "$branch" != *..* && "$branch" != *//* ]]
fi
remote=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$branch" --jq .object.sha)
test "$remote" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$SOURCE_SHA/check-suites?per_page=100" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/stage-b-check-suites.json"
python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/stage-b-check-suites.json" <<'PY'
import json
import sys
items=[item for page in json.load(open(sys.argv[1])) for item in page['check_suites']]
if not items or any(item['status']!='completed' or item['conclusion']!='success' for item in items):
    raise SystemExit('Source SHA requires completed successful GitHub check suites')
PY

steps.name: Require trusted deployment source
Operate only the owned UAT project
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
export STAGE_B_AUTH_SMOKE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/uat/stage_b_smoke.py"
args=(--state-dir "$STAGE_B_UAT_STATE_DIR" --approval-ref "$APPROVAL_REF" --request "$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT")
case "$OPERATION" in
  record_main) python3 scripts/uat/stage_b_deploy.py record-main "${args[@]}" --sha "$SOURCE_SHA" ;;
  release) python3 scripts/uat/stage_b_deploy.py release "${args[@]}" ;;
  feature_mode) python3 scripts/uat/stage_b_deploy.py feature-mode "${args[@]}" ;;
  maintenance) python3 scripts/uat/stage_b_deploy.py maintenance "${args[@]}" ;;
  deploy_feature|deploy_main)
    branch="$SOURCE_BRANCH"
    if [[ "$OPERATION" = deploy_main ]]; then branch=main; fi
    docker_config=$(mktemp -d)
    chmod 700 "$docker_config"
    trap 'rm -rf -- "$docker_config"' EXIT
    export DOCKER_CONFIG="$docker_config"
    printf '%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin >/dev/null
    python3 scripts/uat/stage_b_deploy.py deploy "${args[@]}" \
      --project "$STAGE_B_UAT_PROJECT" --base-compose "$STAGE_B_UAT_BASE_COMPOSE" \
      --branch "$branch" --sha "$SOURCE_SHA" \
      --backend-image "$IMAGE_PREFIX-backend@$BACKEND_DIGEST" \
      --frontend-image "$IMAGE_PREFIX-frontend@$FRONTEND_DIGEST" \
      --migration-hash "$MIGRATION_HASH" \
      --migration-review-ref "$MIGRATION_REVIEW_REF" \
      --migration-approver "$MIGRATION_APPROVER" \
      --backup "$BACKUP_PATH" --backup-root "$STAGE_B_UAT_BACKUP_ROOT" \
      --api-url "$STAGE_B_UAT_API_URL" --frontend-url "$STAGE_B_UAT_FRONTEND_URL"
    ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac

state=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
for field in ('failed_attempt','inflight'):
    state.pop(field,None)
with open(sys.argv[2],'w') as out: json.dump(state,out)
PY
fi
